title: Alternating turn state machine (`PLAYER_TURN` -> `AI_THINKING` -> `ROUND_OVER`), immutable sector claiming, evaluation of all 8 collinear triads (3 ranks, 3 files, 2 diagonals) plus 9-sector Equilibrium Deadlock detection, and instant `[SPACE]` / Click bout reset.
author_role: Lead Gameplay & Kinematics Specialist (State machines, physics integration, collision rules)
summary: Implements the alternating turn state machine, immutable sector inscription, win-line/draw resolution over 8 collinear vectors, and instant bout resets.
technical_specification: Initialize `state.stats.grid = Array(9).fill(null)`, `state.stats.phase = 'PLAYER_TURN'`, `state.stats.winner = null`, `state.stats.winVector = null`, `state.stats.aiTimer = 0`. On `SPACE` or `pointer.down` while in `PLAYER_TURN`, if `grid[selectedIndex] === null`, assign `'BLADES'`, emit `CELL_INSCRIBED`, and switch to `AI_THINKING` (with `aiTimer = 0.35`). Evaluate win against 8 collinear indices: `[[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[0,4,8],[2,4,6]]`. If matched, set `winner` and `phase = 'ROUND_OVER'`. If no win and all filled, set `phase = 'ROUND_OVER'`, `winner = 'DEADLOCK'`. When `ROUND_OVER`, pressing `SPACE` or clicking resets `grid`, `winner`, `winVector`, and returns to `PLAYER_TURN`.
acceptance_criteria: Claiming a sector permanently locks its value against overwriting for the remainder of the round.
Collinear completion immediately freezes turn input, records the 3-index vector, and marks victor.
9 filled cells without a 3-in-a-row triggers Equilibrium Deadlock status.
Space or click during ROUND_OVER fully resets the board and starts a new duel.
